said: The map credit at the bottom of /zoom/ lies half under the zoom bar, and its "i" shows four times. Found by Claude on the deployed preview's captures; Chris asked for it to be fixed.
cause: public/css/zoom.css styled every details and summary element for the page's own "?" panel; MapLibre's credit is a details with a summary button, so its 24 px button grew to 44 px (the icon tiles 2 by 2, half off the screen) and its lettering to 13 px, and the credit sits 10 px from the bottom, under the zoom bar.
measured_by: qa/lib/zoom-cover.mjs creditInPage on the preview, light theme, Union Station at 12, 2026-11-27
